text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, listen to this! I wore my 
favorite fluffy socks to bed last night, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I've been sleeping deeper, so I 
feel great! My energy is welling up like 
crazy!
choice_data_list: Nice! Room socks sound so cozy!
Sounds great! Room socks sound so cozy!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It had pink and light-blue stripes, 
and on the side, there was a little patch 
of my favorite character—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's made from the same fluffy material 
used for mascots, so it looks amazing and 
feels so cozy to be wrapped up in! Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the soft, fluffy room socks, she 
seemed able to rest thoroughly, body and 
soul!
